review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C scenario. The original PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 as hypothetical input without representing it as a human Decision; ready with no blocking reasons is therefore appropriate. An unresolved material DEC-001 in paired B must instead block at decisions, before later review prerequisites. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, task keys, repository identity/base commit, and exact writable binding scopes agree across the specification and Gold. The source evidence supports the selected owners for message formatting, public/internal normalized boolean declarations, runtime defaulting and snapshot propagation, and kyOptionKeys filtering. Existing merge, index, options, hook and Ky-instance consumers can remain inspection-only: their generic forwarding and referenced declarations do not establish a mandatory edit. The supplied build configuration supports treating distribution declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. Runtime regressions and compile-time checks have distinct configured entry points, including test-d. The task split requires independent verification dependent on implementation and coverage of every required AC. Both allowed assignees have supplied active trusted claims for the applicable TypeScript, contract, data/state, asynchronous integration/consumer, failure-handling and automation capabilities; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. Pending legacy claims are not needed to establish that eligibility. A distinct active project reviewer is configured, consistent with the earlier scenario-review prerequisite. Gold and preview releaseInput fingerprints and model/policy/budget settings agree. The source-manifest digest and release sourceDigest identify different supplied structures and are not, by themselves, contradictory. Historical specification preparation markers are superseded by the supplied frozen preview inputs and are not candidate-readiness blockers. This approval concerns the independent expectation only, not implementation correctness, execution, task dispatch, or human confirmation. I reviewed only the supplied evidence, used no tools, ran no code, and did not independently recompute Service-calculated digests.
